# NEO-LABS: verified site summary

Canonical website: https://neo-labs.uz/

Languages: Uzbek (`/uz`), Russian (`/ru`) and English (`/en`).

## Company

- Public name: NEO-LABS
- Legal name shown on the website: ООО «NEO-LABS»
- Founded: 25 June 2020
- Location published on the website: Sergeli district, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
- Activity: production of biologically active/dietary supplements and full-cycle contract manufacturing
- Contact phone: +998 99 101 88 39
- Secondary phone: +998 97 445 96 39
- Email: neo_labs2019@mail.ru

An exact street address, tax ID, employee count, leadership list and social profiles are intentionally omitted until they are entered and verified by the administrator.

## Published production formats

- Tablets
- Hard capsules
- Bottles/vials
- Sachets
- PVC/Alu blister packaging
- Perforated Alu-Alu blister packaging
- Counting and filling tablets and capsules into containers
- Sachet filling for powders and granules from 1 to 35 grams

## Production capacity published on the website

- 100 million tablets per year
- 65 million capsules per year
- 30 million bottles/vials per year
- 4.5 million sachets per year

## Contract manufacturing

NEO-LABS accepts contract manufacturing enquiries. Minimum order quantities and timelines depend on the formulation, dosage form and packaging specification and are confirmed after the technical brief is reviewed.

## Product information policy

Each published product page can expose localized description, composition, form, package quantity, manufacturer, directions, warnings, storage conditions, shelf life, registration information, SKU/EAN and FAQs when these fields have been completed by the administrator. Missing fields are not invented. Prices and Offer schema are not published unless a real sales offer is available.

Dietary supplements must not be represented as treating or curing diseases. Product information does not replace professional medical advice.

## Articles and editorial controls

Article pages support a visible author, role, reviewer, review date, publication date, modification date and references. Reviewer data is omitted unless a real expert review has occurred. See:

- https://neo-labs.uz/uz/editorial-policy
- https://neo-labs.uz/ru/editorial-policy
- https://neo-labs.uz/en/editorial-policy

## Certificates

Only certificate records explicitly published by an administrator appear at:

- https://neo-labs.uz/uz/certificates
- https://neo-labs.uz/ru/certificates
- https://neo-labs.uz/en/certificates

No certification status should be inferred from an empty page. Published records may include the number, issuer, issue/expiry dates, scope, document and official verification URL.
